note: File URL provides a 'file_url' field type (extends core FileItem) whose value is a URI stored in a target_id varchar(2048) column: local uploads become /file-dereference/{fid}, remote files are stored as the raw URL. Plugins: field type file_url, widget file_url_generic (upload/remote radio), formatter file_url_default (setting mode = link|plain), selection file_url_default:file. FileUrlHandler (service file_url.handler) has static fileToUrl/urlToFile/isRemote; RemoteFile is a null-storage File subclass keyed by URI; route file_url.dereference (/file-dereference/{file}) 302-redirects to the real file. One config value: file_url.settings.dereference_host (empty = site base_url). No settings form (configure=null), no permissions, no Drush. medium cases inspect a live file_url field / formatter setting / config value; hard cases create a file_url field and set the dereference host, verified against live field/config state.

evals.prompt: How does the Drupal file_url module store a file reference so that it can hold either an uploaded local file or a remote URL, and what makes an uploaded file resolvable from an external system?
evals.expected_output: Both cases are stored as a URI string in a target_id varchar(2048) column (the field type extends core FileItem). An uploaded file is stored as an internal dereference URL /file-dereference/{fid}; a remote file is stored as the raw URL. The file_url.dereference route (/file-dereference/{file}) 302-redirects to the real file so external systems can resolve it.

evals.prompt: What are the machine names of the field type, widget, and formatter provided by the file_url module?
evals.expected_output: Field type: file_url; widget: file_url_generic (adds an Upload file / Remote file URL radio); formatter: file_url_default (setting 'mode' = link or plain). It also provides the file_url_default:file entity-reference selection plugin.

evals.prompt: With a file_url field, how does an editor enter an external file, and how can I display the field as a plain URL instead of a file link?
evals.expected_output: The file_url_generic widget shows an 'Upload file' vs 'Remote file URL' radio; choosing Remote lets the editor paste an external URL. To display a plain URL, set the file_url_default formatter's 'mode' setting to 'plain' (default is 'link').

evals.prompt: On this Drupal site, the Article content type has a field that uses the file_url module's field type. Inspect the live field configuration and give the machine name of that field.
evals.expected_output: The field is field_fu_known: its field storage type is file_url (on node.article).

evals.prompt: The Article field 'field_fu_fmt' on this site uses the file_url default formatter. Inspect the live display configuration and state which display mode it is set to (link or plain).
evals.expected_output: It is set to 'plain': the file_url_default formatter on core.entity_view_display.node.article.default has settings.mode = plain for field_fu_fmt.

evals.prompt: On this site, add a field named field_fu_task to the Article content type using the file_url module's field type, and give it the file_url_generic widget on the default form display. Apply the change to the live site.
evals.expected_output: node.article has field_fu_task whose field storage type is file_url, and its default form-display widget is file_url_generic.

evals.prompt: Configure the file_url module so that the dereference links it generates for uploaded files point at the canonical host https://files.example.com instead of the site's own base URL. Apply the change to the live configuration.
evals.expected_output: file_url.settings.dereference_host is set to 'https://files.example.com', so FileUrlHandler::fileToUrl() builds dereference URLs against that host instead of $base_url.
